source_message.text:
Darius,

For the last round, I’ve provided the final chapter set along with the updated image tracker. There are no additional photo assets available for this round, so the work should concentrate on the manuscript, image placeholders, and tracker.

Whenever a visual is still required, please identify the type of image or graphic that would be most suitable and include any recommendations that could strengthen the visual plan.

Before the manuscript enters its next production phase, this round should ensure that all remaining chapters have a clear and usable image strategy.

Thank you!
Marisol
